list_llvm_optimization_passes: list all available LLVM optimization pass actions from the actions enum
get_observation_space_options: get all observation space types from the observation_spaces enum for CompilerGym LLVM env
get_reward_space_options: get all reward space types from the reward_spaces enum for CompilerGym LLVM env
lookup_pass_description: lookup the human-readable description of an LLVM pass from the action_descriptions enum
iterate_observation_spaces: iterate over all observation space enum members to find available observation types
